_about: Every place the mod touches Eslabong. One row = one game system/file the mod hooks or overrides. 'resPath' and 'method' come from the recovered project (GDRE Tools) and stay unverified until read. No game files are shipped; the mod pck only adds files or extends scripts.

rows.purpose: Load the mod pck and register mod content before the main menu
Add the 6 Wasteland classes to the game's class list
Run the mod's ability scripts through the game's ability/cooldown system
Offer Wasteland classes in the merc market
Add the Wasteland league as a selectable league with its rival clubs
Load Wasteland arenas for Wasteland league matches
Rename gold to Caps and scale prizes in the Wasteland league
Keep saves loadable if the mod is removed (mod data stored separately)
